name: nyuark/nyuruns
description: nyuArk's Rapid Unified Network Services: a lightweight PHP 8 framework for RESTful APIs and web pages, with built-in authentication, input validation, several data sources and document formats.

suggest.ext-zip: To read zipped documents: Office, OpenDocument and EPub files
suggest.ext-gd: To change pictures: resize, crop, turn, and strip what they carry
suggest.ext-imagick: To draw SVG pictures as PNG, JPEG or WebP
suggest.ext-exif: To read what a photo tells: date, camera, position
suggest.ext-mongodb: To use MongoDB as a store
suggest.ext-openssl: To sign the tokens with RS256 and keep the 2FA secrets encrypted
suggest.phpmailer/phpmailer: To send mails with attachments through a phmail mail account
